name: Collio

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Collio whites are typically full bodied and rich, made from one grape or a blend of Friulano, Ribolla Gialla, Malvasia, Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio and Sauvignon Blanc.
Most producers aim for fresh fruit and pure varietal character.

blurb.text: A white wine zone in the Gorizia Hills of Friuli-Venezia Giulia, on the border with Slovenia. Red wine is also made.
